one_line: The later Mughal emperor of Delhi, caught between Nader Shah’s wrath and his own terrified subjects during the 1739 sack of Shahjahanabad.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium height, slightly rounded build with a courtly bearing that still shows hints of youthful softness.
appearance.face: Oval face with a light brown North Indian complexion, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, straight nose, expressive dark eyes with slightly heavy lids, a calm yet strained default expression that mixes dignity with quiet worry.
appearance.hair: Straight, dark brown hair kept short and mostly hidden under a tall, slightly tapering Mughal turban wrapped in rich cream fabric with a subtle gold weave, fronted by a single emerald-green sarpech plume ornament set in gold.
appearance.costume: A long, knee-length Mughal jama of fine silk in muted rose red with tiny gold buta motifs, fastened left-over-right and tied with a wide pale-gold silk patka sash featuring a narrow green border, worn over slim off-white churidar trousers; on top, a sleeveless quilted khilʿat-style coat in deep bottle green with fine gold edging and light vertical quilting lines, and on his feet soft brown leather mojari shoes with upturned toes, subtly embroidered in gold thread; a simple but elegant pearl-and-emerald mala hangs at his neck and a narrow gold kara bracelet circles his right wrist.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted Mughal talwar sheathed at his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with understated gold fittings, its subtly curved steel hilt wrapped in dark green fabric; in scenes he usually rests one hand on the hilt without fully drawing it, emphasizing a ruler trapped in violence rather than a battlefield warrior.

ref_desc: Muhammad Shah is a late-30s Mughal emperor with a light brown oval face, short beard, cream turban with emerald sarpech, wearing a rose-red patterned silk jama, green quilted sleeveless coat, off-white churidar, brown mojari shoes, and a sheathed dark-brown-scurabbarded talwar at his hip in rose red, bottle green, cream, pale gold and off-white tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Muhammad Shah, late-30s Mughal emperor with a light brown oval face, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, expressive dark eyes and a default expression of quiet, strained dignity; his straight dark brown hair is short and mostly hidden under a tall, slightly tapering cream-colored Mughal turban with a subtle gold weave and a single emerald-green sarpech plume ornament at the front. He wears a knee-length rose-red silk jama patterned with tiny gold buta motifs, wrapping left over right and tied at the waist with a wide pale-gold silk patka sash that has a narrow green border. Over this, show a sleeveless quilted khilʿat-style coat in deep bottle green with fine gold edging and visible vertical quilting lines. His slim off-white churidar trousers bunch gracefully at the ankles above soft brown leather mojari shoes with gently upturned toes and subtle gold embroidery. Add a simple pearl-and-emerald bead necklace and a narrow gold kara bracelet on his right wrist. At his left hip hangs his signature Mughal talwar in a dark brown leather scabbard with understated gold fittings, its gently curved hilt wrapped in dark green fabric; he rests one hand lightly on the hilt without drawing it. Present him front and three-quarter views to show consistent face, turban, costume and weapon, using a cohesive palette of rose red, bottle green, cream, pale gold and off-white.
